summary: Main-ion dilution fraction for one main and one impurity charge state.

identity.direction: charge states -> dimensionless main-ion density fraction
identity.definition: One-main/one-impurity quasineutrality algebra; denominator is evaluated in stages to avoid avoidable overflow.
identity.model: Main-ion dilution relation with explicit SciRel numeric boundary checks
identity.coordinates: broadcast impurity and effective-charge arrays; main charge scalar
identity.boundary: positive finite Zi and Zimp, distinct Zi/Zimp, and Zeff between charge states
assumptions: This relation does not infer arbitrary multi-ion composition.

inputs.name: Z_i
inputs.dtype: real integer/float numeric scalar or zero-dimensional numeric array; converted to float64
inputs.constraints: finite and strictly positive; nonempty, boolean/string/complex/masked values rejected

inputs.name: Z_impurity
inputs.dtype: real integer/float numeric scalar or array-like; converted to float64
inputs.constraints: finite and strictly positive; nonempty, boolean/string/complex/masked values rejected

inputs.name: Z_eff
inputs.dtype: real integer/float numeric scalar or array-like; converted to float64
inputs.constraints: finite and between Zi and Zimp; nonempty, boolean/string/complex/masked values rejected

outputs.name: result
outputs.constraints: finite and in the algebraic physical range

preconditions: positive finite Zi and Zimp, distinct Zi/Zimp, and Zeff between charge states
supported: Finite NumPy evaluation of the declared relation and broadcast shape.
excluded: Whole-transport evolution, experimental calibration, and implicit coordinate reconstruction.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for boolean/string/complex/masked or empty input, non-finite values, malformed or incompatible shape, and the nonpositive or singular domains named by the callable contract.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Raises FloatingPointError if accepted finite inputs produce an unrepresentable output; no fallback is returned.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; this is a direct algebraic mapping.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No output is returned after an exception.

example.description: Run the relation on a finite declared-domain case.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.physics import calculate_main_ion_dilution_factor
r=calculate_main_ion_dilution_factor(1., 6., 2.5)
assert np.isclose(r, .7)

scope: Independent species charge-balance construction, endpoints, singular boundaries and large-charge representability.
Declared failure cases for empty, boolean/string/complex/masked, nonfinite and incompatible inputs.
Agreement with the canonical SciRel callers and dependencies of this relation.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Maintained tests establish the named relation, shape and selected boundary behavior only; they do not establish global physical calibration.
known_limitations: The one-impurity model is not a general ion mixture solver.
Charge-state physical interpretation is caller-owned beyond the declared ordering.
